name: civi-mcp
description: Read-only access to CiviCRM via APIv4. MCP server with four generic query tools (list_entities, describe_entity, get, count) for natural-language CRM queries from Claude Desktop.

civi_base_url.title: CiviCRM Base URL
civi_base_url.description: Base URL of your CiviCRM site, e.g. https://civi.example.org

civi_api_key.title: CiviCRM API Key
civi_api_key.description: Personal API key on your CiviCRM user (Contact -> API key field).
